# Agentic Builders

> Agentic Builders is an early-stage venture fund (idea to pre-seed) for agent-native products: products AI agents use and tools for building agent products. First checks of $30–100k on a standard post-money SAFE. One form; for teams that fit, a four-week track and a decision on a first check at its end. Apply: https://accidental-podium-c67.notion.site/a5032a0b4b1982f89291014f2df73ba9 · Contact: hey@agenticbuilders.ai · Updated 2026-10-20.

## Pages

- [For founders](https://agenticbuilders.ai/): program, thesis, selection, team, portfolio, FAQ
- [Full reference for AI agents](https://agenticbuilders.ai/llms-full.txt): fund details, program terms, application instructions and field schema
- [Portfolio](https://agenticbuilders.ai/portfolio/): companies, introductions for angels and VCs, monthly newsletter
- [Team](https://agenticbuilders.ai/team/): people, responsibilities and how we use AI
- [Privacy policy](https://agenticbuilders.ai/privacy/): how application and contact data are handled
- [Legal notice](https://agenticbuilders.ai/legal/): operator, program terms and disclaimers

## Portfolio

- [Eqvesta](https://eqvesta.com/): Autonomous family office for the first $200,000.
- [Silow](https://silow.ai): Prioritized plans for AI adoption.
- [Heron](https://heron.ing/): AI agent review and audit platform.
- [kone](https://kone.vc): The monetization layer for AI agents.
- [Agentiqa](https://agentiqa.com): Visual, agentic, self-healing test automation.
- [Theona](https://theona.ai): No-code AI agent platform for business tasks.
- [HookRadar](https://hookradar.net): Competitive ad intelligence.
- [VisibilityPro](https://visibilitypro.ai): Generative Engine Optimization platform.
- [Aprena Academy](https://aprena.academy/): AI-powered career guidance.
- [Fina](https://fina.team/): Financial automations.
